properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive KDF dependency of sshpk in the Hardhat/Ethereum dev toolchain. The template's own code (Solidity + TS tests) never invokes it; it ships with `npm install` as part of the ganache/waffle chain. Changeable only by swapping or upgrading the transitive dependency, not by editing this repo's code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Toolchain-only signature capability (Shor-vulnerable, deadline risk rather than harvest risk). Observable here, replaceable only by the upstream packages (sshpk, @metamask/eth-sig-util). No application call site in this template.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 in this tree derives Ethereum wallet material (mnemonic seeds, keystore encryption keys) and backs ganache's scryptsy. Quantum-safe as a construction; the ECDSA keys it protects are the quantum-vulnerable part. Vendor/toolchain-controlled, not app code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The tweetnacl capability in this tree serves sshpk's Ed25519 SSH key type and @metamask/eth-sig-util's signing/recovery utils. No application code invokes it. Observable here, vendor-replaceable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js is the memory-hard KDF that protects ethers v5 JSON keystores (Web3 Secret Storage v3, default N=131072) — the wallet file format developers encrypt test account keys with. Toolchain dependency; changeable by upgrading ethers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The hash engine of the browserify crypto stack that ganache-core (via ethereum-waffle) installs. Note it ships SHA-1 alongside the SHA-2 family. Toolchain dependency; no app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js is elliptic's hash/HMAC-DRBG substrate — it participates in every secp256k1 ECDSA signature the ethers/ethereumjs toolchain produces. Also used by @ethersproject/sha2@5.6.1 for SHA-256/SHA-512. Toolchain dependency.
